pr_title: Use NetAnalyzers from SDK instead of FxCopAnalyzers
pr_body:
Fixes #30099

- [x] ~~Replaces FxCopAnalyzers package references with NetAnalyzers.~~ (Used from .NET SDK instead of package)
- [x] Deletes rulset files
- [x] Migrate rulesets to editorconfigs

@sharwell Can you review?
pr_comments:
There CA1310 violations like:

https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/c925f99cddac0df90ed0bc4a07ecda6b054a0b02/src/Razor/Microsoft.AspNetCore.Razor.Language/src/Components/ComponentBindLoweringPass.cs#L499

Do you want me to pass a StringComparison.Ordinal, or StringComparison.Invariant, or disable the rule?

*I'm not sure why the `main` branch doesn't fail with this error. It's already enabled without my changes* :smile:
Looks good so far - let me know when you're done.

Due to large number of violations for many rules, I'm switching from AllEnabledByDefault to Default mode. Waiting on CI to see how many violations will be, fix them, review deleted rulesets, and convert them to global configs as @sharwell suggested.

Global configs are indeed much better as they integrate very well with MSBuild properties (for example, they allow having different rules easily for tests vs. product code).

There are some violations of CA1305 from <https://github.com/aspnet/MessagePack-CSharp.git> which is imported through gitmodules. I'll move this specific rule to .editorconfig instead of .globalconfig as a workaround.
This should be ready for another look.

issue_context.title: Migrate from FxCopAnalyzers to NetAnalyzers
issue_context.body:
FxCopAnalyzers package is deprecated. The repository should use `Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers` instead.

See [Migration guide](https://docs.microsoft.com/visualstudio/code-quality/migrate-from-fxcop-analyzers-to-net-analyzers).
